questions.question: In the text, what does the word "battered" mean?
questions.explain_en: "Battered" here means the market was damaged or hurt by the sell‑off.
questions.explain_zh: 「battered」在文中指的是市場受到賣壓而受損。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX suffers 7th-steepest point drop, diving 3.59% in global tech sell-off

questions.question: On which date did the TAIEX drop 1,612.60 points?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the plunge happened on Tuesday, Nov. 3.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要說明跌幅發生在 11 月 3 日（星期二）。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX suffers 7th-steepest point drop, diving 3.59% in global tech sell-off

questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "capital‑expenditure" mean?
options: Money spent on buying equipment and building facilities
questions.explain_en: It refers to money a company spends to buy equipment or build facilities, not profit or savings.
questions.explain_zh: 指公司用來購買設備或建設設施的支出，而不是利潤或儲蓄。
questions.news_title_en: NDC head says AI-spending jitters to rattle TAIEX only briefly

questions.question: According to the summary, why should the impact on local shares be short‑lived?
options: Because the AI technology is being banned
Because hardware makers still have strong order backlogs
Because the government will lower taxes
Because foreign investors are leaving Taiwan
questions.explain_en: The officials said strong order backlogs at hardware makers will keep the AI‑driven export engine strong, limiting the share drop.
questions.explain_zh: 官員指出硬體製造商仍有強勁的訂單積壓，將維持 AI 出口引擎的活力，因而使股價下跌影響有限。
questions.news_title_en: NDC head says AI-spending jitters to rattle TAIEX only briefly

questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "high-asset" mean?
options: Having a lot of money or valuable assets
questions.explain_en: "High-asset" describes clients who hold a large amount of wealth, in this case more than NT$100 million each.
questions.explain_zh: 「high-asset」指的是擁有大量資產的客戶，本文指的是每位客戶持有超過1億新台幣的財富。
questions.news_title_en: High-asset bank clients top 32,000 as FSC wealth push gains traction

questions.question: How many banks were approved to offer high-asset wealth management by the end of September?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that 25 banks are now approved to offer high-asset wealth management.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到目前有 25 家銀行獲准提供高資產理財服務。
questions.news_title_en: High-asset bank clients top 32,000 as FSC wealth push gains traction

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "diverged" mean?
questions.explain_en: "Diverged" means the performance of the ETFs moved apart, showing different results.
questions.news_title_en: Active ETFs near NT$1 trillion as Taiwan's fund boom rolls on

questions.question: How much net inflow did domestic issuers pull in from January to May?
questions.explain_en: The summary states domestic issuers attracted about US$13.6 billion during that period.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說，國內發行人從 1 月到 5 月吸引了約 13.6 億美元的資金流入。
questions.news_title_en: Active ETFs near NT$1 trillion as Taiwan's fund boom rolls on

questions.question: According to the summary, when must recipients of gifts made within two years of a giver's death pay estate tax?
options: Only if the gift exceeds a certain amount
Only if they decline to inherit
Regardless of whether they inherit, based on their share
Only if they inherit the whole estate
questions.explain_en: The amendment requires recipients to pay estate tax on those gifts in proportion to their share, even if they decline to inherit.
questions.explain_zh: 修正案規定，受贈人在贈與人死亡前兩年內的贈與，必須按其份額繳納遺產稅，即使他們拒絕繼承也要繳稅。
questions.news_title_en: Cabinet estate- and gift-tax overhaul targets pre-death gifting loopholes

questions.question: In the text, what does the word "normalize" mean?
options: to make something usual or standard
questions.explain_en: Here "normalize" means to bring the discount rate back to a normal level, i.e., make it usual or standard.
questions.explain_zh: 在文中 "normalize" 指的是把貼現率恢復到正常水平，也就是讓它變得常見或標準。
questions.news_title_en: Central bank minutes reveal board split over whether to lift 2% rate

questions.question: What is the central bank's CPI forecast for 2026?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the bank's 2026 CPI forecast is 2.03 percent.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明央行對2026年的消費者物價指數預測是2.03%。
questions.news_title_en: Central bank minutes reveal board split over whether to lift 2% rate
